# 📚 Documentation PR - monday.com MCP Server Integration Guide

## 🔗 Related Issue / Epic
Closes #916 

---

## 📝 Summary 
Added comprehensive documentation for the monday.com MCP Server integration, covering OAuth2.1 authentication, tool operations, webhook configuration, troubleshooting, and best practices for integrating monday.com with MCP Gateway.

---

## ✏️ Type of Change
- [ ] Typo / formatting
- [ ] Outdated or incorrect info
- [ ] Missing explanation / example
- [ ] Unclear instructions
- [x] New page or major rewrite
- [ ] Other (describe)

---

## 📄 Changes Made

### New Documentation Added
- **Location**: `docs/docs/using/servers/external/monday/monday-mcp.md`
- **Scope**: Complete integration guide (1,519 lines)

### Key Sections Included

1. **Overview & Features** - Introduction to monday.com MCP capabilities
2. **Prerequisites** - Account setup, OAuth registration, required permissions
3. **Authentication Setup** - OAuth2.1 flow, token management, manual configuration
4. **MCP Gateway Integration** - Server registration, SSE endpoints, webhooks, health checks
5. **Available Tools** (18 tools documented):
   - Board Management (create, get, update, delete)
   - Item Operations (create, get, update, move, duplicate)
   - Column Management (create, update, delete)
   - User & Team Management
   - Workflow Automation
   - Time Tracking
   - File Management
   - Reporting & Analytics
6. **Usage Examples** - 5 practical scenarios with code samples
7. **Troubleshooting** - OAuth issues, SSE problems, rate limiting, workspace access
8. **Configuration Examples** - Complete server configs, webhooks, Docker Compose
9. **Best Practices** - Security, performance, error handling, development tips
10. **Related Resources** - Official docs, community links, tutorials

### Documentation Quality
- ✅ Follows MCP Gateway documentation structure
- ✅ Includes practical code examples and configurations
- ✅ Comprehensive troubleshooting section
- ✅ Security best practices included
- ✅ Ready for `make markdownlint spellcheck`

---

## 🔍 Preview Instructions
```bash
cd docs && make serve
```
Navigate to: `/using/servers/external/monday/monday-mcp/`
